name: ai-sales
description: Install ai-sales directly from its own repository. For the whole AI Team use the HPAIF/ai-team catalog.

plugins.name: ai-sales
plugins.description: AI Team in-house sales assistant for founders doing founder-led B2B sales: target-account list from the shared ICP, privacy-respecting prospect research from public information, outreach drafts, a pipeline register, discovery-call prep and notes (SPIN, MEDDPICC), proposals and deal reviews. Never sends messages, contacts prospects or commits to prices, discounts or terms.
